name: Ash Crop
blurb: Mud-brown crop. Short enough that your forehead can still participate.

name: Ink Fall
blurb: Ink-black hair that refuses to stop at the jaw. It has a back to haunt.

name: Rose Drape
blurb: Candy-pink curtains of hair. People will see you coming. That's the point.

name: Striped Coat
blurb: Lilac coat, plum stripes, slim sleeves. Looks like you raided a magician's wardrobe.

name: Pink Hoodie
blurb: Blush hoodie with a marshmallow tummy. Striped sleeves because one pink wasn't enough.

name: Winter Coat
blurb: Big red coat with white fluff. You will be warm. You will look like a wrapped present.

name: Sneakers
blurb: Chalk-grey runners with a black toe. For sprinting absolutely nowhere.

name: Camo Pants
blurb: Moss camo from the waist down. Hide in the bushes. Or the couch. Same vibe.

name: Christmas Sweater
blurb: Pine sweater with a little red tree on it. Wear it in July. Start arguments.

name: Baggy Skull Pants
blurb: Huge charcoal baggies. Your shoes are in there somewhere. Probably.

name: Football Helmet
blurb: Maroon helmet, white stripe, scary little visor. You are legally required to yell HUT.

name: Moon Pants
blurb: Night-grey pants with moons on them. For stomping around at 2am looking haunted.

name: Heartbreaker Hair
blurb: Dusty rose bangs that say I did this on purpose. The rest just... falls.

name: Open Plaid
blurb: Maroon flannel, left wide open. Buttons are for cowards.

name: Bear Hat
blurb: You are a ginger bear now. Ears and everything. Mouth still works for snacks.

name: Anonymous Mask
blurb: Cream smirk, black brows. Nobody knows it's you. Everybody knows it's you.

name: Skull Mask
blurb: White skull. Tiny horns. Halloween called, it wants its whole personality back.

name: Ombre Fall
blurb: Black and white gradient hair, like burnt ends! (with less fire tho!)

name: Knee-High Converse
blurb: Black converse that go UP. Checker stripe so people know you mean it.

name: Leather Jacket
blurb: Black leather, white zipper, will not zip. Cooler that way.

name: Dark Sweatpants
blurb: Near-black sweats. The official pants of I'm not going outside.

name: Brown Shoes
blurb: Low maroon oxfords, brown so the dirt doesn't show up when u STOMP around!
